text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut race has finally 
arrived. Smart Falcon wears a nervous 
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She possesses the strength of heart to 
perform a street live even with zero 
audience. Yet, even with such a strong 
heart, she cannot escape the pre-race 
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You can win if it's a dirt race." 
Encouraged by her Trainer's words, Smart 
Falcon heads out to the race.
